name: Inverse Rendering Loss Function
aliases: Composite Loss for Neural SDF and Material Optimization
definition: A composite loss function used to optimize neural SDF and material parameters from multi-view photometric images, combining image fidelity, structural similarity, SDF validity, and material constraints.
summary: The Inverse Rendering Loss Function optimizes neural SDFs and material parameters by combining image fidelity with geometric and lighting constraints, distinguished by its use of SDF entropy regularization and light regularization for shadow disentanglement.
